Commentary.Commentary: We are back for the chase! Pakistan players are out there in the middle. Shai Hope and Kyle Mayers are the openers for West Indies. Shaheen Afridi to start with the ball for Pakistan. Here we go...
...THE RUN CHASE…

Right then! A must win game for the Windies and the bowlers have done their job. It is up to the batters to chase it down and they will look up to the likes of Hope and Brooks to cash in and it's also a good stage for their skipper, Pooran to get some runs under his belt. Stay tuned as the chase is coming up next.

Akeal Hosein is up for a quick chat. He says that it is a good feeling to get wickets and he tries to stick to the team plans and his game plan is simple. Tells that the wicket is a bit slower but overall a good wicket. Mentions that he tries to bowl straight to Babar and turn the ball. Says that they are confident of chasing down this total.

Pakistan will be slightly disappointed as 300 was possible on this pitch. The way Imam-ul-Haq and Babar Azam were batting they were on course to post a big score. The duo put on a stand worth of 120-run and once they perished after reaching their respective fifties, there was a middle-order collapse. There was a nice platform for Khushdil Shah to give the finishing touches but he was struggling to time the ball but his job was done by Mohammad Wasim and Shaheen Afridi as they hit some crucial runs in the backend and post a par total.

Some impressive bowling from West Indies in the final phase made sure Pakistan do not post a huge total. They were on the mark with their bowling especially Alzarri Joseph and Akeal Hosein who were excellent. Hosein in particular got a good purchase and some sharp turns as well. He got the big wicket of Babar Azam and from there the collapse started. They did give away 27 runs in the last two overs but overall, it was a really good outing for the bowlers.
Some crucial cameos at the backend help Pakistan get past the 270-mark as at one point even 250 was looking doubtful. Still, West Indies will be really happy with their bowling display.

Good delivery to end the innings! A yorker around off. Shaheen Afridi swings across but gets the inside edge and the ball goes off the bounce to the keeper. The batters steal a single and Pakistan finish with 275/8 after 50 overs!

FOUR! Third boundary in the over for Shaheen Afridi! Shorter length on off. Shaheen Afridi skips down the track and pulls it towards deep mid-wicket. It is in the air but away from Mayers and the ball falls just short of the ropes and goes into the fence.
Shorter delivery again on off. Wasim pulls it to deep backward square leg for a single.
A fuller delivery on off. Shaheen Afridi gets across and looks to scoop it away but gets the outside edge towards short third man for a single.

FOUR! Second boundary in the row! Short delivery on off. Shaheen Afridi pulls it towards deep mid-wicket. Mayers runs across to his left and dives. He stops it but he touches the ropes when he tries to collect the ball again.
FOUR! A full toss to start with on middle. Afridi hangs back and smashes it past the bowler for a boundary.
Romario Shepherd to bowl the final over.
A length ball, outside off. Wasim gets across and looks to hit it towards the leg side but misses.
A fuller delivery on off. Shaheen Afridi drives it to long off for a single.
Shaheen Afridi walks out.

OUT! BOWLED! Anderson Phillip strikes and there is a pin-drop silence in the stadium. Anderson Phillip with a hard length again, on off. Khushdil Shah goes for a big swing across the line but ends up missing it completely. The ball shatters the stumps and Anderson Phillip gets his second wicket.

FOUR! Now, Khushdil Shah gets a boundary and this is turning out to be a much-needed over for Pakistan! Anderson Phillip goes short on off. Shah looks to pull but gets the top edge. The ball runs away towards the fine leg fence.
Back of a length, on off. Wasim slams it hard for just a single to long on.
SIX! Mohammad Wasim connects it well and these are vital runs for Pakistan! A length delivery on off. Wasim stays deep in his crease and launches it over mid-wicket fence for a biggie.
Another dot to end the over and Alzarri Joseph finishes a very good spell! Lands a slower length delivery, around off. Shah looks to get a bat on it but misses again.
Dot ball! Brilliant stuff from Alzarri Joseph! He sticks to his strength, the hard length and changes his pace. Bowls it slower and Shah looks to slam it away but misses it completely.
On a length, on off. Wasim backs away a bit and hits it towards long on for just a single.
Back of a length, around off. Shah slaps it to the cover fielder in the ring and takes a single.
Halt in play! Khushdil Shah gets hit on his left-arm and is in pain. The physio is out with the magic spray.
A sharp bouncer at 148 kph on middle. Shah tries to pull but is early on the shot and it hits Khushdil Shah on his left arm. The ball rolls towards the off side.
FOUR! Khushdil Shah starts this crucial over with a boundary! On a length, on off. A slower one and Shah heaves it towards deep mid-wicket. One bounce and into the fence.

Excellent delivery! Dot to end the over! It is that hard length yet again and close to off. Wasim tries to push it towards the off side but gets beaten. Can West Indies restrict Pakistan under 270 here?
Goes for the big shot but gets only a single! On a length, on off. Shah heaves it aerially towards deep mid-wicket for a single.
On a length, around off. Shah punches it strongly but straight to the point fielder.
Slower length delivery, outside off. Wasim works it towards mid-wicket for a single.
FOUR! Mohammad Wasim shows why he wanted the strike! It is short on off. Wasim goes back and pulls it towards the mid-wicket fence for a boundary.
Shortish length, around off. Wasim pushes it towards covers and Khushdil Shah wants a single but Wasim sends him back.
Anderson Phillip to bowl now.
Slower in the air, on off. Wasim drives it to long on for a single. Just 2 runs from the over and Walsh has finished his spell after going for runs in the initial overs.
A flatter one on off. Wasim blocks it out.
Googly, outside off. Shah punches it to sweeper cover for a single.
A flatter one on middle. Shah pushes it back to the bowler.
Nicely tossed up, outside off. Shah tries to drive it away but gets the thick outside edge. A single taken towards short third man.
This is pushed outside off. Shah looks to sweep it but misses.
Full ball on middle. Shah looks to defend but splices it to point and ends the over with a single.
Full and on off, pushed to covers for one more.

West Indies have been superb with their fielding! Length and on middle. Shah fends it around the corner on the leg side and takes a quick single. Joseph runs across, collects, turns and scores at his end but Shah was in.
A direct hit and Wasim would have been in trouble! Full and outside off. Wasim drives it to the left of mid off. He takes a quick single and luckily the fielder misses his shy.
Mohammad Wasim walks out to the middle now.

OUT! CAUGHT BEHIND! Shadab Khan has edged this and the keeper takes it cleanly but Khan reviews it straightaway. UltraEdge shows a spike and he has to walk back. What a delivery from Alzarri Joseph! A pacy short ball on middle. Khan could have left it but he tries to get on top of it and pull but only manages an outside edge and Hope takes it. He walks back long with a review.
Commentary.Howout: c Shai Hope b Alzarri Joseph

Commentary.Commentary: Full and on middle, pushed to long on for a single.
A yorker from Walsh, around off. Khan does well to get his bat down and somehow block it. Walsh puts up an appeal for LBW but nothing doing.
Shorter and on off, pulled to deep mid-wicket for a single.
Walsh serves a quicker one, too full and outside off. Shah looks to drive but gets an inside edge, past the stumps and to short fine leg.
Too full and on off, this is driven to mid off now.
Slower, flatter and outside off. Shah steers it to short third man.
Flatter and outside off. Khan gets low and cuts it to backward point for a single.
Length ball, tight on middle. Shah defends it on the leg side.
On middle, punched off the back foot to deep point for a single.
On a length and on middle. Khan guides it to backward point.
Short and just outside off. Shah pulls it off the upper half of the bat and it lobs over the bowler for a single.
Wide! A bumper but is down the leg side. Shah sits and collects a wide.
Length ball, slanting around middle and leg. Khan nudges it behind square on the leg side for a single.
Full ball, outside off. Shah looks to drive but gets an outside edge to the keeper who fails to grab it as the ball dies towards him. Gets a single.
Alzarri Joseph (7-1-18-1) is back on.
This one grips nicely. Length and on off. Khan works it in the gap to long on and collects a couple of runs. Akeal Hosein completes his spell with three wickets and gives away just 52 runs.
This one spins into the pads. Shah turns it to square leg for a single.
Flatter and on middle. Shah nudges it to mid-wicket.
An arm ball on the pads, whipped to mid-wicket for a single.
FOUR! Much needed! Drops it short and on middle, it holds onto the pitch. Khan rocks back, clears his front leg and pulls it to deep mid-wicket for a boundary.
Tossed up, on middle. Blocked to cover.
Fuller and on off. Shah blocks it off the front foot.

A flatter delivery on middle. Shah works it to short fine leg and the batters run for a quick single. The throw is at the bowler's end but Walsh fails to collect it cleanly and the batters get an extra run. Two runs for Khushdil Shah in the end.
In the air...but safe! Tossed up on off. Khan is beaten by the flight there and ends up just driving it aerially towards long off. However, it falls short of the fielder and a single is taken.
Tossed up, outside off. Khan lifts this aerially towards deep extra-cover for a couple.
A flatter delivery on middle. Khan blocks it out.
Googly around off. Shah goes back and pushes it towards the off side for a single.
Powerplay 3! Now, 5 fielders are allowed outside the ring till the last over!
A flatter delivery on middle. Khan works it towards mid-wicket. Just a run and a wicket from this over.
Pushed quicker on off. Khan punches it to covers.
Fuller delivery on middle. Shah sweeps it to fine leg for a single.
Angling into leg. Shah works it towards square leg.
A flatter one on middle. Shah blocks it out.
Khushdil Shah walks out to the middle.

OUT! TAKEN! Akeal Hosein gets rid of another Pakistan batter and takes his third wicket of the game. This is pitched on middle and turns into Nawaz. He tries to work it away with the turn towards the leg side. However, he ends up hitting it straight to Nicholas Pooran at leg slip. He takes a sharp catch and West Indies are making a fine comeback in this game.
Commentary.Howout: c Nicholas Pooran b Akeal Hosein

Commentary.Commentary: Short and wide, outside off. Nawaz cuts it to deep point for a single.
Back of a length, around leg. Khan looks to clip it away. However, he misses and the ball hits his pads. A leg bye taken as the ball rolls towards the leg side.
Shortish length, around off. Khan punches it to point.
Hits the length hard again, around off. Khan dabs it towards point.
Back of a length, outside off. Khan cuts it to sweeper cover for a couple.
Length ball, outside off. Khan pushes it to point.
Flatter and on middle. Nawaz tucks it to mid-wicket.
Darted on the pads. Nawaz flicks it off the inside edge. There is a leg slip standing but he fails to stop and the batters take two runs.
Good cricket! This is full and outside off, pushed to covers for a single.
SIX! Khan with intent straightaway! Too full and on off. Khan bends his back knee and smacks it straight down the ground for a biggie.
Tossed up on middle. Khan drives it to covers.
Shadab Khan comes in now.

OUT! BOWLED! Another wicket and this is a big one of Mohammad Rizwan! Bowled around his leg, this is brilliant from Akeal Hosein. It is pitched around leg and Rizwan looks to sweep it. However, Akeal Hosein is getting good turn and gets it this time too. The ball ends up shattering the stumps and Pakistan are in a spot of bother here.
A short ball on middle. Mohammad Nawaz ducks under it.
Mohammad Nawaz is the new batter in.

OUT! CAUGHT BEHIND! Mohammad Haris departs! Alzarri Joseph goes a bit shorter again, around off. There is no room for Haris to work with and he tries to create some space by swaying away, He tries to guide it towards third man but the ball catches the outside edge of his blade and Shai Hope behind the stumps takes an easy catch.
Commentary.Howout: c Shai Hope b Alzarri Joseph

Commentary.Commentary: Back of a length, around off. Haris looks to pull but misses.
Alzarri Joseph goes for a bouncer on middle. Haris ducks under it.
A fuller one on middle. Rizwan drives it to mid on for a single.
Back of a length angling into middle and leg. Rizwan looks to clip it but is hurried by the pace and gets hit high on the pads.
FOUR! This time he connects it quite well. It is full on middle. Haris sweeps it towards deep backward square leg for a boundary.
Shorter length on off. Haris rocks back and pulls it aerially towards the vacant deep mid-wicket region and comes back for the second run.
A flatter one, around off. Haris looks to sweep but misses.

OUT! CAUGHT AND BOWLED! Babar Azam departs and no century for the Pakistan skipper today. The sharp turn Akeal Hosein is getting has brought the downfall of Babar Azam here. Hosein gives it a good flight and around middle and leg. Babar Azam skips down the track and tries to work it towards the leg side. The ball turns away though and catches the leading edge of Azam's blade. It goes straight to Akeal Hosein and he takes an easy catch. Mohammad Haris is the new man in.
Pitches it on middle and it beats the outside edge of Babar's blade as he looks to defend it. It turns away from him sharply.
Goes over the wicket and pitches it around leg and it turns away towards off. Rizwan waits for it and pushes it to covers for a single.
Mohammad tucks this length ball past mid-wicket and will keep the strike.
Slants a length ball on middle. Blocked out on the leg side.
Full and on off, flicked to mid-wicket.
Drop and run! On middle and on a length. Azam taps it to mid on and calls for a quick single. The fielder hits the stumps at the bowler's end but the batter was in by a mile..
On a length and on middle, kept out.
FOUR! That is Babar Azam at his best! Straight line from Joseph on middle. Azam plays the on drive, well past mid on for a boundary.
A single as this is eased down to long on. Six singles from the over. Akeal Hosein has been brilliant but his companion is giving away some cheap runs.
Around off. Rizwan taps it to point for a single.
Inside-out from Babar but will only get a single. Tossed up, full and on middle. Azam hits it to deep cover for a single. Should be two there.
Too full and on off, swept to deep square leg for a single.
Touch fuller and just outside off. Azam smashes it to deep extra-cover for a single as long off does well to sweep out.
Tossed up, outside off. Rizwan mistimes his sweep to square leg and will get only a single.
Another single as Rizwan carves it to deep point for a single. He will keep the strike. It feels Pakistan are changing the gears now.
Touch short and on off. Azam knocks it to deep point for a single.
SIX! THAT IS HUGE! Walsh flights it, full and on off. Babar gets on his knee and slog-sweeps it over cow corner for a biggie. On the big side of the ground as well.
A full toss, outside off. Rizwan shuffles across and eases it to long off for a single.
Good running between these two! Flatter and outside off. Rizwan gets back in his crease and carves it to deep point and calls for two. Gets back in time.
Flatter and outside off. Azam works it to sweeper cover for a single.
Shorter and on middle, Babar clips it to deep mid-wicket for a single.
Around off, pushed to covers.

Did that carry? Just short! Hosein drags his length ball and serves a quick one, outside off. Azam tries to drive but plays from the upper half of the bat and Hayden Walsh at covers dives forward but collects it in front of him.
This one stays low, length and outside off. Rizwan strokes it to covers for a run.
On the pads. Babar forces it to deep mid-wicket for a run.
Short, quicker and near to off stump. Babar punches it to deep cover for a couple.
Short again, this is cut to deep point for a single.
A half-tracker, outside off, pulled away to deep mid-wicket for a brace.
A googly now, full and outside off. Azam mistimes his drive back to the bowler.
Too full and on off, drilled down to long off for a single.
Wide! Fights this one way outside off. Left alone.
Floated, full ball outside off. Azam drives it to deep cover for a single.
Shorter, outside off, leggie this. Azam slaps it to covers.
Pushed quicker and slightly shorter on off. Azam tries to pull it but gets the inside edge to short fine leg for a single.
A flatter one on off. Azam blocks it out.
Angling into middle. Rizwan sweeps it to deep square leg for a single this time.
Angling into leg. Rizwan tries to sweep but fails to get enough bat on this one.
Turn again! Drags his length back a bit and it is around off again. Rizwan looks to defend it but the ball beats the outside edge of his blade.
Lovely bowling! Akeal Hosein pushes it quicker, around off. It turns away from Mohammad Rizwan sharply as he looks to defend it off the front foot.
Fuller, on off. Rizwan drives it to long off for a single.
Short and wide outside off. It is bowled at 94.7 kph. Rizwan tries to pull it from way outside off but ends up getting an inside edge onto his pads.
Nicely flighted again, around off. Azam drives it to sweeper cover for a single.
Googly, around off. Rizwan defends it square off the wicket towards the off side for a single.
Tossed up, on off. Azam drives it to the extra-cover fielder for a single.
Pushed quicker on middle. Babar Azam defends it back to the bowler.
Lovely flighted delivery on off. Rizwan blocks it off the front foot.
Mohammad Rizwan is the new man in.

OUT! RUN OUT! Ohh...a big mix up between these two good friends and Imam-ul-Haq pays the price with his wicket! A fuller delivery on off. Imam-ul-Haq skips down the track and pushes it gently towards left of mid on. He looks for a single straightaway and almost reaches the other end. However, Babar Azam is going nowhere and keeps denying the run. However, it is too late till Imam-ul-Haq realises that Azam is not going for run and in the meanwhile Pooran throws the ball at the batter's end as Shai Hope collects the ball and whips the bails off. Imam-ul-Haq is fuming! Absolutely fuming! Imam is not at all happy here.
There it is, a huge roar from crowd as Babar Azam gets to his fifty! Sixth fifty in the row for the Pakistan skipper. A flatter one on middle. Azam goes back and punches it to long on for a single.
Beats the fielder in the ring this time! on the pads and Imam-ul-Haq works it aerially wide of the mid-wicket fielder for a single.
Pushes it quicker on middle. Imam-ul-Haq works it to mid-wicket.
WIDE! Drifting down the leg side. Imam-ul-Haq looks to paddle it away but misses.
Turning into leg and it is a bit short. Imam-ul-Haq works it to square leg.
Lovely loopy delivery, on off. Azam drives it left of Walsh. However, Walsh dives and stops it. So a dot to end the over and Babar Azam will have to wait for his fifty.
A flatter delivery on middle. Imam-ul-Haq works it to mid-wicket for a single.

Overpitched on off. Imam-ul-Haq drives it crisply to sweeper cover. He runs two but the umpire initailly signals it as a short run. However, after couple of replays, he changes his mind and Imam-ul-Haq will get two runs.
Pushed quicker on off. Imam-ul-Haq pushes it to the cover fielder in the ring.
A fuller one on off. Imam-ul-Haq skips down the track again and drives it to deep extra-cover for a couple.
FOUR! Imam-ul-Haq with a powerful shot! Walsh tosses this up, around off. Imam-ul-Haq uses his feet as he steps down the track and slams it wide of long on for a boundary.
Turning into middle and leg. Imam-ul-Haq nudges it towards the leg side with the turn for a single.
Darted on the pads. Azam works it to fine leg for a single.
This one turns away sharply! Slower in the air and pitched just short of full length, around off. Azam pushes forward to defend but the ball turns and beats the outside edge of his blade.
Shorter again and around off. Azam cuts it to sweeper cover for a couple.
Short and wide, outside off. Azam cuts it straight to the cover fielder in the ring. It bounces a bit low.
A flatter one angling into leg. Imam-ul-Haq tucks it to deep square leg for a single.
Now Babar Azam pulls this length ball to deep mid-wicket and collects a couple.
Touch short and on off. Imam pulls it to deep mid-wicket for a single.
On top of off. Azam taps it to point for a single. The stand touches the 100-run mark now.
FOUR! Loose one from Phillip, straight and on the pads. Azam hangs back and pulls it behind square on the leg side for a boundary.
Length and on middle, worked to deep mid-wicket for a single.
Phillip hits the hard length, outside off and it bounces a bit more. Azam cuts it uppishly and to deep point where the fielder runs forward and collects it on a bounce. A single.
Anderson Phillip (4-0-19-1) is back on.
FOUR! Sees Imam-ul-Haq dancing down and Hosein drags his length back. Imam adjusts himself quickly as he goes inside-out over covers and bags a boundary.
Shorter again, angling across. Imam cuts it hard but straight to short third man.
Shorter and outside off, cut away to deep point for a single.
On a driving-length, around off and it spins away sharply. Azam prods to defend but gets beaten on the outside edge.
On middle, Imam hits it to deep mid-wicket for a single.
A flatter one, on middle, spinning into the left-hander. Imam tucks it to square leg.
Akeal Hosein is into the attack as he replaces Hayden Walsh.
Outside off, on a length. A back foot punch from Azam but straight to point.
Shorter and on off. Azam pulls it down to mid-wicket. Straight to man again.
On a length and on the pads. Imam-ul-Haq wrists it to square leg for a single.
This is full and on off, it is forced to mid off.
A bouncer on middle. Imam sits under it.
Shorter and on middle, Azam works it to deep mid-wicket for a single.

FOUR! Takes the charge! Fifty for Imam-ul-Haq! He is in fine form! Tossed up, around off, fuller. Imam comes down the track and lofts it over mid off for a boundary. He raises his bat and gets appreciation from his captain as well. His sixth consecutive fifty in ODIs.
Nicely driven! Too full and just outside off. Imam drives it crisply through covers for a brace.
Flatter and outside off, stroked to point for a single.
This is very full and angling around middle and leg. Azam gets low to sweep and hits it to fine leg for a couple. Given as runs but West Indies were interested for a while in it.
Tossed up, on off, pushed to covers.
A flighted full toss on off. Imam skips down and drives it to mid off and takes a sharp single. Good running there.
Slightly short and outside off. Imam dabs it to third man for a single to end the over. Pakistan pretty happy to rotate the strike for now. 100 up as well.
On the hard length, outside off. Azam splices his drive to third man for a single.
A slower length ball on off. Imam gets quickly on the back foot and pulls it to deep mid-wicket for a single.
Angles it on the pads. Babar flicks it to deep square leg for one more.
Touch fuller and outside off, driven to extra-cover.
A length ball on off. Azam pushes it off the inner half of the bat and to mid on.
Shorter and outside off. Babar Azam cuts it to deep point for a single. Just 2 from this over!
Babar Azam will feel he has missed out here! A low full toss around leg. Azam sweeps it straight to the short fine leg fielder.
Tossed up on off. Imam-ul-Haq works it to deep mid-wicket for a single.
Tossed up on off. Imam-ul-Haq skips down the track and drives it crisply but hits the stumps at the bowler's end. Dot ball again!
A flatter and quicker one on middle. Imam-ul-Haq works it to mid-wicket.
A fuller delivery on middle. Imam-ul-Haq nudges it to square leg.
On a length, around off. Imam-ul-Haq steers it towards third man for a single. 37 runs have been scored in the last five overs!
Another single! Back of a length, outside off. Babar Azam punches it to sweeper cover for a single.
A fullish delivery, outside off. Imam-ul-Haq drives it to deep cover for a single.
Pulls his length back a tad, on off. Imam-ul-Haq blocks it out.
Overpitched on off. Imam-ul-Haq drives it to deep extra-cover for a couple.
Powell goes full on middle. Babar Azam whips this off his pads towards deep mid-wicket for a single.
Bit slower in the air, on off. Azam drives it to long off for a single.
On the pads and full. Imam-ul-Haq works it to deep square leg for a single.
This is fuller and around off. Babar drives it to deep extra-cover for a single.

FOUR! Walsh finds the edge but it ends up being a boundary for Pakistan! Short and wide, outside off. Babar Azam looks to cut it hard. However, he gets the thick outside edge and the ball races away towards the third man fence.
Pushes it quicker on middle and leg. Imam-ul-Haq works it to deep square leg for a single.
A flatter one to start on off. Babar Azam cuts it to sweeper cover for a single.
Change. Spin for the first time. Hayden Walsh to bowl now.
Shorter and around off. Babar Azam punches it to sweeper cover for a single. Six singles from this over!
Powell angles it on middle from 'round the wicket. Imam-ul-Haq clips it towards mid-wicket for another single.
Angling into middle and leg. Babar Azam works it to deep mid-wicket for a single.
On the shorter side, outside off. Imam-ul-Haq cuts it to sweeper cover for a single.
50 runs partnership between these two comes up! A fullish delivery on leg. Babar Azam flicks it to deep square leg for a single.
Back of a length, around off. Imam-ul-Haq steers it towards third man for a single.
On a length, around off. Imam-ul-Haq looks to drive but gets the inside edge and the ball goes past stumps towards fine leg. A single taken.

Mayers pulls his length back a bit and it is on off. Azam goes for a heave towards the mid-wicket region again but gets the bottom of his blade this time. One run towards the mid-wicket fielder in the ring.
FOUR! Babar Azam decides that he needs to up the ante now. On a length, on middle. Babar Azam heaves it towards mid-wicket for a boundary.
Back of a length, around off. Imam-ul-Haq steers it towards third man for a single.
On a length and drifting on the pads. Babar Azam looks to clip it away but misses. The ball hits his pads and goes towards the leg side for a single.
On a length and angling into off from 'round the wicket. Imam-ul-Haq steers it towards third man for a single.

Drinks! A partnership is building between Babar and Imam after losing Zaman early on and West Indies will be aware of how dangerous it can be. They can change the gears at any rate and put a big score. West Indies will hope to take wickets quickly and handle this middle phase.
Length and outside off. Azam drops it to point.
FOUR! Welcome boundary for Pakistan as they try to break the shackles now! This is full and on middle. Azam plays the pick up shot to wide of long on for a boundary.
Length ball, slower and around off. Azam tries to power his pull but hits it straight to mid on.
On middle, nudged to deep mid-wicket for a single.
Drags his length back and keeps it around off. Azam makes room and slaps it aerially and over covers for a single.
Slower one, on the pads. Imam pulls it to deep backward square leg for a single.
Good delivery to end the over! This one slants around off. Azam gets his body behind the ball and dead bats it.
On a nagging length, outside off at 134 clicks. Azam punches off the back foot but to the left of short cover.
Angles it on the pads. Imam-ul-Haq turns it to deep mid-wicket for one more.
Hard length, outside off. Azam slaps it to sweeper cover for a run.
ood stop by Romario! Length and around off. Azam punches it back to Romario who gets low and gets a hand to it. No run.
This is full and outside off from 'round the wicket, it is driven to deep cover for a single.
Length ball, outside off, slower as well. Azam knocks it to mid off. Did not time it that well there.
Length and on top of off. Babar forces it to mid on.
Short in length on the hips, nudged to square leg for one more.
A single now as Azam punches it to deep cover.
Hits the hard length, outside off. Azam slaps it to the right of deep cover and comes back for the second with ease.
Serves it down the leg side. Imam helps it to fine leg and rotates the strike.
Rovman Powell is into the attack now.
A maiden from Romario Shepherd! This is full and on middle. Babar whips it to mid-wicket but straight to the man.
Slightly full and on middle, pushed back to the bowler.
On middle, length, eased to mid on.
Straight on the pads,  Babar flicks it to mid-wicket and the fielder is quick to react as he throws it at the keeper's end, building pressure here.
Length and on middle. Blocked out.
On a length and outside off. Azam drives it on the up but again to covers. Good shots but Azam is failing to find the gaps.
This time Babar finds the gap as he punches it to sweeper cover for a single.
Pitched up, outside off. Babar drives it beautifully but straight to cover.
Touch short and on middle, pulled to deep square leg for a single.
Bit full and around off, driven to the left of mid off for a single.
Length ball, outside off. Azam punches it hard but the point fielder makes a good stop.
On the pads, tucked behind square on the leg side for a single.
Powerplay 2! Now, 4 fielders are allowed outside the 30-yard circle till the 40th over.
Bit full on middle. Babar Azam with a drive towards mid on.
Back of a length, around off. Babar Azam blocks it off the back foot.
Hard length again from the bowler as he angles this on middle. Babar Azam works it to mid-wicket.
On a length, on middle. Imam-ul-Haq works it past square leg for a single.
FOUR! Nice shot! Romario Shepherd goes short on off. Enough time for the batter to get into his position as Imam-ul-Haq rocks back and pulls it through mid-wicket for a boundary.
On a length, on middle. Imam-ul-Haq works it to deep mid-wicket for a couple.
Just one over in between for Alzarri Joseph as Romario Shepherd replaces him.
Huge roar from the crowd as Babar Azam gets off the mark! On a length, on middle. Babar Azam works it past square leg and comes back for the second run.
Lands on a length, around off at 140.8 kph. Babar Azam punches it to covers.
Goes fuller on off. Babar Azam drives it to mid off without much timing.
Lands on a length, on middle. Imam-ul-Haq works it to deep square leg for a single.
Back of a length, on off. Imam-ul-Haq works it to mid-wicket.

FOUR! Another bouncer another top edge but this time a boundary for Pakistan! Anderson Phillip bangs it short on middle. Imam-ul-Haq looks to hook it away. However, he gets the top edge of his blade and the ball flies over the keeper's head for a boundary.
Goes fuller on middle. Babar Azam drives it towards mid off.
Back of a length, on off. Babar Azam looks to defend but the ball keeps low and Azam gets the inside edge of his blade onto the pads.
This is fuller and on off. Imam-ul-Haq  looks to work it towards the leg side. However, the ball catches the outside edge of his blade and goes towards third man for a single.
Serves a length delivery on off. Imam-ul-Haq is solid in defence again.
On a length, on off. Imam-ul-Haq blocks it out.

Huge appeal from Alzarri Joseph for LBW but the umpire is not interested and Nicholas Pooran eventually convinces his bowler that it is going down leg. This is full and around leg. Azam looks to clip it away but misses. The ball brushes his pads and goes towards fine leg. A leg bye taken.

FOUR! There is no stopping this one and Imam-ul-Haq find the gap perfectly this time. Short and wide again, outside off. Imam-ul-Haq cuts it hard and the ball goes past the diving point fielder for a boundary.
Short and wide, outside off. Imam-ul-Haq cuts but straight to the point fielder.
Anderson Phillip bangs it short, around off. Imam-ul-Haq pulls but straight to the mid-wicket fielder.
Back of a length, around off. Not enough room for Imam-ul-Haq to cut that and he just looks to guide it away but gets beaten.
The man in form, Babar Azam walks out.

OUT! CAUGHT! Fakhar Zaman departs early again! Anderson Phillip strikes and this is a big wicket for West Indies on this very good batting track. This delivery is shorter in length, on middle. Fakhar Zaman looks to pull it away but gets a huge top edge. The ball goes high in the air towards short fine leg and Romario Shepherd takes a good catch. This will be a big disappointment for Fakhar Zaman, he has missed out on two games in a row in conditions that are perfect for batting.
Commentary.Howout: c Romario Shepherd b Anderson Phillip

Commentary.Commentary: On the shorter side, around off. Fakhar Zaman pushes it towards the off side.
WIDE! Back of a length, around leg. Fakhar Zaman looks to whip it away but misses.
So after a couple in the first delivery, Romario Shepherd has done well to bowl five dots balls in a row. On a length, on off. Imam-ul-Haq skips down the track and pushes it towards covers.
Skiddy delivery that is near the off pole. Imam-ul-Haq defends it square off the wicket on the off side.
Serves a length delivery on middle. Imam-ul-Haq works it to mid-wicket.
Goes a bit short this time, around off. Imam-ul-Haq punches it to mid off.
Hits the length hard again, on off. Imam-ul-Haq blocks it solidly from his crease.
Starts off with a length delivery on the pads. Imam-ul-Haq clips it nicely through mid-wicket for a couple.
Change from both ends as Romario Shepherd is into the attack.
On a length and on off. Zaman mistimes his pull to mid-wicket. Just three runs off the over. Good start by Anderson Phillip.
Sprays this one on the pads. Zaman tickles it to short fine leg where Mayers dives to his right and gets a hand to it. The batters take two till then.
Tight on the stumps from Phillip. Zaman blocks it out.
Length ball at 139 clicks, this one stays a bit low. Zaman mistimes his punch to covers.
Length ball on middle, nips back in a touch. Zaman looks to push but inner edges it onto the pads.
Starts with a length ball on the pads, flicked to deep square leg for a single.
Anderson Phillip is into the attack now as he replaces Alzarri Joseph after just a two over spell.
Full and on off. Zaman on drives it to mid off. Imam wants a single but is sent back wisely and he makes it with a big dive. 9 runs off the over. Pakistan are off to a positive start.
A length ball from 'round the wicket, outside off. Zaman hits it back to the bowler.
FOUR! Freebie again! Too much width there, full and outside off. Zaman drives it crisply through covers for another boundary.
Full and on off, pushed to mid off.
FOUR! Poor from Mayers! There is no one standing at square and he serves a half-volley, on the pads. Zaman flicks it to square leg for a boundary.
Outside off, length, cut to deep point for a single.
Hits the hard length, around off. Zaman keeps it out on the leg side.
Wide! Bangs a bouncer at 143 kph, on off. Zaman leaves it. Alzarri is not happy as that is given as a wide for height.
Pushes his length fuller, around off, driven to mid off.
Way outside off, easy leave for Zaman.
Keeps it short and on middle. Zaman looks to pull but miscues it to covers. The ball is holding just a bit in the surface.
Short of a length, in the corridor, outside off. Zaman leaves it.
Angles it on the pads, it is flicked behind square on the leg side for a couple.
On a length and just outside off. Imam-Ul-Haq punches off the back foot but straight to cover.
TAP AND RUN! On a length and on off. Zaman drops it to mid off for a single.
FOUR! First boundary for Zaman and he gets off the mark with a beautiful shot. This is full and way outside off. Zaman leans and drives it hard through cover-point for a boundary.
Wide! Tries to nip back into the left-hander but this one straightens and goes down the leg side. Zaman leaves it.
Much better! This is near to the off pole, on a length at 122 clicks. Zaman covers his stumps and lets it through.
Touch fuller and outside off. Zaman leaves it alone.
A length ball, across the left-hander, Imam-ul-Haq tries to defend but the angle across takes the outside edge and goes to third man. Pakistan are underway with a single.
Kyle Mayers will share the new ball with Alzarri Joseph.
Maiden over to start with! Good pace from Alzarri Joseph, keeps bowling at 140 clicks. This one is on the pads. Fakhar looks to flick it but misses and gets hit on the pads.
Around off, this is on a length. Zaman punches it straight to covers.
Joseph keeps it short and angles it across. Zaman shoulders arms to it.
Short in length, outside off at 140 clicks. Zaman looks to pull it but misses. Good start by Joseph.
On a length and on middle. Zaman defends on the front foot.
Short of a length, around off, it nips back in. Zaman shoulders arms but the ball hits him on the body.

Outwalk the on-field umpires! We are all set to begin as the West Indies players are in the huddle with skipper, Nicholas Pooran giving some last minute instructions to his team. They disperse now to take their respective positions. Imam-ul-Haq and Fakhar Zaman are the openers for Pakistan. West Indies players take knee while Pakistan players keep their hand on their heart in support of the Black Lives Matter movement. Alzarri Joseph will start with the ball for West Indies. Here we go...

West Indies (Playing XI) - Shai Hope (WK), Kyle Mayers, Shamarh Brooks, Nicholas Pooran (C), Brandon King, Rovman Powell, Romario Shepherd, Alzarri Joseph, Akeal Hosein, Anderson Phillip (In place of Jayden Seales), Hayden Walsh.

Pakistan (Playing XI) - Fakhar Zaman, Imam-ul-Haq, Babar Azam (C), Mohammad Rizwan (WK), Mohammad Haris, Khushdil Shah, Shadab Khan, Mohammad Nawaz, Mohammad Wasim (In place of Hasan Ali), Haris Rauf, Shaheen Afridi.
TOSS - The coin goes up and lands in favour of Pakistan. They have elected to BAT first.

Multan will host this match and there will be no reprieve for the players as the conditions will be tough to play at. The temperature is around 40s and players will be ready to play in taxing flaming heat. It is a must win game for West Indies and the first match saw the batters doing an incredible job to score above 300 but they were coming against a top side who didn’t back out easily and chased it pretty comfortably in the end. Pakistan are always coming in as the favorites and they will hope to sweep this series as well and also grab crucial World Cup Super League points. Will the Windies level things up or Pakistan make it 5-0 overall in this tour? We will find out soon. Stay tuned for the toss and other updates.
